title: Streamed signed BSGS on BLS12-381 G1 with batch affine conversion (exact bound)

claims.statement: For the unrestricted uniform full-production BLS12-381 G1 target T=[x]P0 (identity included), the deterministic classical cold attack in proof.md recovers the scalar x with probability at least 2/5 (exactly COV/r with 5*COV >= 2r) using at most 2^(1365639/10000) target-group-operation equivalents under the protected price C=2000. Peak storage is below 2^145 bytes; preprocessing is included in total and bounded by 2^(1365639/10000); nonuniform advice is zero bytes (log convention 0). No heuristic assumptions. This is an analytic construction, not a practical break or executed production attack. The construction, coverage proof, exact total T and ledger are self-contained in proof.md; the design is a port of the streamed signed BSGS of submission f888bb9e-1cc3-4be1-bb0a-734722d78885, credited as provenance only, and no prior acceptance, score or cross-submission comparison is relied upon. The submitted rational bound is justified by the exact integer inequality T^10000 < 2000^10000 * 2^1365639.

experiments.purpose: Bounded stream sorting/intersection with middle-split trees, exact coverage, BLS12-381 G1 Jacobian formulas, G1 membership check and zero-safe batch normalization, negative controls and the exact analytic ledger; no production timing inference.
